prd.title: Per-Incident Chain Segment Viewer
prd.overview: The Per-Incident Chain Segment Viewer is the dedicated page where operators (Priya/Adi/Karim) and Phase 2's Pia verify chain integrity per-incident in one click. This is the load-bearing surface for Goal 2.1 (chain verifiable by independent hash recomputation) and Goal 2.3 (100% of chain reads logged). Verification is single-click — no two-click confirm, no captcha, no operator-typed challenge phrase. The act of clicking is operator authorization.

scope.scenarios: 06-audit-chain-timeline-cross-cutting (Screen 2); consumed by 01 (Priya dispute), 02 (Adi override audit), 04 (Karim lineage), 05 (Pia drill-to-incident)
scope.platform: Read /api/chain/blocks + /api/chain/head; verify via /api/chain/verify (reuses web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts); emit ChainRead on mount + ChainAnomalyAcknowledged / ChainAnomalyEscalated on user action

requirement.title: Mount route at /incidents/:incident_id/chain for utility_operator
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx; wrapped in RequireSession with role guard utility_operator.

acceptance.criterion: Route renders for utility_operator
Non-operator roles redirect

requirement.title: Reuse web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts (no copy-paste)
requirement.description: Import verifyBlock from web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts. Closes the gap noted in 000-tech-audit.md §7. Helper has typed VerifyState union; never throws.

acceptance.criterion: verifyBlock call goes through the helper (verified by import trace)
No copy-pasted verify logic in this page
All 4 VerifyState variants render correctly (idle / pending / ok / fail)

requirement.title: Single-click independent verification
requirement.description: Independent verification button (no two-click confirm, no captcha). Calls verifyBlock(latest_block_hash) via helper. Pass: ✅ badge with CheckCircle2 icon within 200ms using --color-safe-green (#2F6E45). Toast auto-dismisses after 3s; durable badge in row metadata.

acceptance.criterion: One click triggers verify (no second click needed)
Pass badge renders within 200ms (mock); color = --color-safe-green
Toast auto-dismisses at 3s; badge persists in row

requirement.title: 60s hash recomputation cache
requirement.description: Cache verified results by (incident_id, last_known_seq) for 60s. Cache hit returns cached VerifyState without re-fetching. Cache miss after 60s recomputes.

acceptance.criterion: Two clicks within 60s: second click uses cached result (verified by fetch count)
Click after 60s: recomputes (fetch count increments)

requirement.title: Anomaly surfacing (row + banner)
requirement.description: Row ⚠️ when recomputed hash ≠ stored hash. Persistent top banner: Chain anomaly detected on inc_... — escalate to Pia. Banner has aria-live=polite and persists across page navigations until acknowledged.

acceptance.criterion: Anomaly row renders ⚠️ icon
Top banner shows incident ID + escalation prompt
Banner has aria-live=polite attribute

requirement.title: Acknowledge / Escalate anomaly emit chain events
requirement.description: Acknowledge button emits ChainAnomalyAcknowledged{actor, incident_id, seq}. Escalate button emits ChainAnomalyEscalated{actor, incident_id, seq} (routes to placeholder Phase 2 queue).

acceptance.criterion: Acknowledge emits correct event payload
Escalate emits correct event payload
Banner dismisses after acknowledgment

requirement.title: Emit ChainRead on mount
requirement.description: Per PRD §11.1, 100% of chain reads must be logged. On mount, POST /api/events with ChainRead{actor, incident_id, filter_combo: ['all']}.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly one ChainRead event fires per mount
Payload contains actor (from session), incident_id (from route), filter_combo=['all']

requirement.title: Operator-mode render (full payloads, hashes, JSON)
requirement.description: Each row expandable to show structured payload as JSON. Copy-to-clipboard on hash anchor. Use 27 approved Lucide icons for event types.

acceptance.criterion: Row expansion shows JSON payload
Hash anchor copy-to-clipboard works
Event-type icon uses one of 27 approved Lucide icons

requirement.title: Area Labels + primitives from web/src/components/ui/
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: incident-chain-segment-page, …-header, …-main, …-timeline, …-event-row, …-actor-chip, …-seq-marker, …-hash-anchor, …-verify-button, …-verify-badge, …-anomaly-banner, …-anomaly-acknowledge, …-anomaly-escalate. requirement.title: MSW: chain anomaly fixture + event handlers
requirement.description: Add sample anomaly block to web/src/mocks/fixtures.ts (recomputed hash differs). Add MSW handlers for ChainAnomalyAcknowledged + ChainAnomalyEscalated event types.

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Inspect import trace; assert verifyBlock from chain-verify.ts. Force network failure; assert no throw; assert VerifyState.fail returned. Helper reused; never throws.
Mount; click verify once; assert no second click prompt; assert badge within 200ms. Single-click works; badge renders fast.
Click verify; capture fetch count. Click again within 60s; assert no new fetch. Wait 65s; click again; assert new fetch. Cache works; recomputes after 60s.
Use anomaly fixture; mount; assert ⚠️ row + top banner with aria-live=polite. Anomaly UI renders correctly.
Mount with anomaly; click Acknowledge; assert ChainAnomalyAcknowledged event. Mount fresh; click Escalate; assert ChainAnomalyEscalated. Ack/Escalate emit correct events.
Mount; intercept POST /api/events; count ChainRead emissions; assert exactly 1. One ChainRead per mount.
